cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,subprocess
base={"id":"x","version":1,"nodes":["A","B"],"edges":[{"id":"e","source":"A","target":"B","capacity":10}],"commodities":[{"id":"c","source":"A","target":"B","routes":[{"edges":["e"],"weight":1}]}],"domains":[],"max_faults":0,"snapshots":[{"id":"s","bounds":[[0,5]],"controller":[1],"tolerance":0,"observations":[]}]}
def run(obj):
    data=json.dumps(obj)
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd='/')
    return r.stdout.strip()
import copy
cases=[]
# float capacity
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['edges'][0]['capacity']=1.5;cases.append(o)
# bool version
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['version']=True;cases.append(o)
# negative capacity
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['edges'][0]['capacity']=-1;cases.append(o)
# bad route
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['commodities'][0]['routes'][0]['edges']=['nonexist'];cases.append(o)
# wrong obs target
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['snapshots'][0]['observations']=[{"id":"o","metric":"demand","target":"e","lower":0,"upper":1,"domain":None}];cases.append(o)
# unlisted domain in obs
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['snapshots'][0]['observations']=[{"id":"o","metric":"link","target":"e","lower":0,"upper":1,"domain":"zz"}];cases.append(o)
# max_faults too big
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['max_faults']=3;cases.append(o)
# duplicate node
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['nodes']=['A','A'];cases.append(o)
# float bound
o=copy.deepcopy(base);o['snapshots'][0]['bounds']=[[0,5.0]];cases.append(o)
# valid baseline
cases.append(base)
for c in cases:
    print(run(c))
